summary: Executed source lightweight JSON composite-read consistency controls. Unique write/incarnation tokens validate immutable views across accessed library, analysis and security stores. Actual concurrent writes, ABA restoration, restart, bounded conflict, mid-read outage and independent store failures are checked. HTTP failure responses have no partial attachment; writes are not retried. No new processes, durable snapshots or library persistence are introduced. Installed GUI, distributed/multi-file durability and large-export performance remain open.

required_text: ABA content restoration still invalidates the captured generation
a restarted analysis store cannot reuse an old process generation
continuous writes stop after three attempts and release the read context
in-context mutations are refused without executing or retrying writes
each accessed store is captured once and telemetry never carries stored payloads
rejects a mid-read analysis outage and restores original data
only database export requires the separate security-event store
The lightweight project library remains volatile
